verdicts.reason: A blows the 'SINCE 2026' badge up so it nearly matches the FIZZBANG! pill in visual weight, which flattens the hierarchy. It also jams both elements to within about 10px of the canvas edges, so the layout feels cramped and the halftone background loses its breathing room. B keeps the original proportions: the pill stays dominant and centred, the badge stays subordinate with clear spacing, and the background shows around both. Its only flaw is that the badge text is small at this size, though still readable.
